issue_request: FHIR-16982 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to replace wording that suggested ISO 3166 codes could substitute only for a formal full country name with wording allowing substitution for a human readable country name.

additional_context: Address is active and normative in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-30239 refined the same Address.country row to allow ISO 3166 2- or 3-letter codes and MAY language, preserving the FHIR-16982 human-readable-country clarification. Related FHIR-23079 and FHIR-23767 concern broader coded Address parts and do not alter this wording decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/datatypes/address.xml says 'ISO 3166 2- or 3- letter codes MAY be used in place of a human readable country name,' and source search found no stale 'full country name' or old 3-letter-only wording.
